name: requests
_comment_purpose: An access request waiting for a system owner's decision, submitted by an employee (`requester`, as `Name (Team)`) or seeded. `role_id` names a role in amodal/_lib/catalog.ts; `system`, `role`, `sensitivity`, and `manager` are copied onto the row at submit so a reader needs no catalog. review_request reads the row plus the requester's entitlements and other requests, checks it against the access policy, and writes the clamped `recommendation` and the `review_id` of the review for the current `revision`. `status` is the human-owned lane (new -> reviewed -> granted | denied; reviewed -> returned -> new on resubmit, revision + 1): the reviewer only advances it to `reviewed`; `granted`, `denied`, and `returned` (with `returned_note`) are written by decide_request from the approver's click. `received_at` is when the request first arrived; `submitted_at` is when the current revision was submitted. No provisioning fields by design: the example recommends a decision, it never touches a real system.
